spans.s: N. of a gigantic Rākṣasa slain by Bhīma, MBh.
Hiḍimba's sister (who changed herself into a beautiful woman and married Bhīma; he had a son by her named Ghaṭotkaca), MBh.; Kām.; BhP.
हिडिम्ब—जित् m. ‘conqueror of Hiḍimba’, Bhīma, L.
हिडिम्ब—द्विष् m. ‘enemy of H˚’, Bhīma, Dhanaṃj.
हिडिम्ब—निसूदन and हिडिम्ब—भिद्, m. ‘destroyer of H˚’, Bhīma, ib.

हिडिम्ब—वध m. ‘the killing of Hiḍimba’, an episode of the Mahā-bhārata, i, 152-156.
हिडिम्बा—पति or हिडिम्बा—रमण, m. ‘husband or lover of Hiḍimbā’, N. of Bhīma or of Hanumat, L.

हीड्, हीळ्, (cf. √ हेड्) P. Ā. हीडति, or हीळति, ˚ते P. (only in जिहीड, AV.; जिहीळ, RV.; and अहिडत्, GopBr.),
to pull, tear, make angry, vex, offend;
 Ā. (only in [अ॑-] हीडमान, ŚBr. जिहीडे, ˚डिरे॑; जिहीळे, RV.; AV.; जिहीडान॑, RV.; हीडिषाताम्, TĀr.),
to be angry or wroth :
Caus. (only अजीहिडत्) to pull out (hair), AV.
or हीळ॑, m. an instigator, stimulator, RV. viii, 8, 19.
or हीळित॑, mfn. angry, wroth, RV.; Br.
